answer: Keep every new identity in sable: visible on the ledger but unlit, with no weight at all. A public beacon then summons a random sample of identities each epoch to defend, in their own words and within minutes, one specific deed from their own public history. A sybil farm can script a thousand silent accounts, but it cannot improvise a thousand distinct, coherent defenses at once — and one failed defense burns the bridge for its whole cluster, which must re-earn standing together or not at all.
